subject: Authorize extension: Isabella Chen — comp & level confirmation
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recommendation & ask: Isabella Chen — proposed level/comp

Team,

I’m recommending we move forward with Isabella Chen for the Senior Backend Engineer role. She completed final onsite yesterday and the panel consensus is strong on technical fit + ownership. A few things I need sign-off on so we can extend by EOD Friday (candidate has two other processes heating up):

- Level: panel recommends L5 (senior IC). This would be an exception relative to the posted L4 req; justification attached in the comp matrix.
- Comp ask from candidate: target total cash $230k (base $165k, bonus 15%), plus equity request of 0.35% RSU over 4 years.
- We can offer a $10k signing bonus if needed to close.

Attached: comp_matrix_ISA_20260402.xlsx (manager suggested breakdown and market comps).

Please respond with quick approvals or flags — Marissa specifically for budget/finance sign-off, Laura for leveling/PEO compliance. If we greenlight, Tessa can send a verbal extension and I’ll follow up with a call to the candidate.

Thanks,
Dev
Dev Patel
Engineering Manager, Backend
Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-01T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recommendation & ask: Isabella Chen — proposed level/comp

Thanks Dev — this looks reasonable to me given the strong interview feedback and urgency. I’m OK to proceed with a verbal extension once Finance confirms the cash envelope and Laura confirms leveling.

A couple of asks from recruiting side:
- Please confirm whether the RSU % can be front-loaded year 1 (25% cliff + graded thereafter) or needs to follow standard schedule.
- If Finance is tight, I want clarity on absolute base floor — candidate has indicated base is the most important lever.

I’ll draft a short verbal script for the recruiter call and prepare the formal offer template to attach.

Tessa Morgan
Senior Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-01T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recommendation & ask: Isabella Chen — proposed level/comp

Appreciate the heads up. Quick finance note after reviewing the attached matrix:

- Base at $165k is above the current band for this headcount; we can approve up to $160k base without an additional budget exception.
- If you want $165k base, we need a one-time headcount/comp exception signed by the hiring director (+ people ops sign-off). That’s doable but will take a day for paperwork.
- We can accommodate the 15% bonus target but need to reduce RSU to 0.25% to stay within comp plan ranges for the team.
- Signing bonus of $10k is acceptable as a one-time close incentive.

I’ve attached a proposed adjusted breakdown that meets budgeting constraints (comp_matrix_ISA_20260402.xlsx v2). If Dev confirms flexibility on base (cap at $160k + $10k sign + 0.25% RSU), I’ll approve straight away. Otherwise, I’ll queue the exception and we can aim to sign Friday morning.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Finance & Compensation
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-01T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recommendation & ask: Isabella Chen — proposed level/comp

Marissa — thanks for the quick review. I can accept the proposed adjusted breakdown: base $160k, 15% bonus target, 0.25% RSU, $10k sign-on. The hiring need is urgent (project-critical onboarding Q3) and I think the stretch on base is manageable if we keep equity slightly lower.

Laura — can you confirm leveling for L5 given the scope (cross-team ownership, infra ownership, 6+ years experience)? The panel explicitly called out leadership on reliability projects which aligns with L5 expectations.

If Laura confirms, Tessa please proceed with a verbal extension to Isabella and cc the recruiter. I’ll be available for a short call after the verbal.

Thanks,
Dev
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recommendation & ask: Isabella Chen — proposed level/comp

Confirmed — I reviewed the packet and the panel notes. Leveling rationale supports L5:
- Cross-functional ownership and demonstrated system design for high-throughput services.
- Expected scope includes mentoring and improving team reliability practices.

People Ops approves L5 for Isabella. Standard onboarding terms apply; please include the standard confidentiality and IP language in the offer. Once Finance confirms comp, we can finalize and send the formal offer.

Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Isabella Chen <isabella.chen@gmail.com>, Harrison Talent <recruiter@harrisontalent.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-02T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps — verbal extension for Isabella Chen (pending final comp sign-off)

Hi Isabella — congratulations and thank you again for spending time with our team. We’d like to extend a verbal summary of the target terms while we finalize paperwork:

- Role: Senior Backend Engineer (L5)
- Base: $160,000
- Bonus: 15% target
- RSU: 0.25% over 4 years
- Signing bonus: $10,000 one-time

This is a verbal extension only; the formal offer (PDF) will follow once Finance completes a final sign-off — we expect that within 24 hours. Please let me know if you’d like to accept the verbal and schedule a short call with Dev to walk through the role.

Attaching the draft offer template for transparency: offer_template_ISA_v2.pdf

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
